title: Speaking in Tongues
english: The gift of speaking in tongues was not limited to the apostles, but was also given to others, including Cappadocians and Egyptians, who spoke in their own languages. This was made possible by the activity and grace of the Holy Spirit, which enabled them to communicate with people from different regions. As it is written, tongues appeared to them divided like fire (Acts 2:3), a sign of the Spirit's presence and power. They thought it necessary to be transformed only in speaking in tongues, and the matter was among the most urgent. However, not all who received this gift understood its true purpose and significance. Some thought that speaking in tongues was the only important thing, and they became careless about discussing the teachings of the prophets and the evangelical doctrines with the crowds. They were more concerned with showing off their gift and receiving praise from others, rather than using it to serve and edify the body of Christ. But Christ had taught that whoever drinks from the water that he gives will have a spring of living water in them (John 4:14), and that whoever believes in him will have rivers of living water flowing from their belly (John 7:38).

He said this (John 7:38) about the Spirit, which believers would receive. The Spirit, which believers would receive, is the life-giving drink and water that God and Father is said to give to those who love Him. As the river of God, it is the full waters, the stream of luxury, that quenches the thirst of those who are called to unity through the Spirit, which also gives life in the order of the vine. Therefore, having been called to unity through the Spirit, and having become one body in Christ, let us keep the bond of love unbroken.

For the one speaking in a tongue does not speak to men, but to God. It is necessary to think that interpreting the prophets and speaking in tongues is more for the glory of it; for with faith, hope, and love for God and brothers already assumed and preferred in us, which also has the fulfillment of the whole law, let the other things be added. Then we will also be filled with the gifts of God and will overflow with the gifts of the Spirit. I say that prophesying is being able to interpret the prophets; for after the Only-Begotten became human, suffered, and was raised, and our economy was completed, what time was there for prophecy, or what things were still to be foretold; therefore, prophesying in these things would be nothing else, except that it is only being able to interpret prophecies.

As we listen, and then, as the native word from them is being thrown towards the truth, we will be upright and not wandering interpreters of the most beautiful things. The one who speaks in tongues is not speaking to men, but rather to God.

But how can this be, since no one can hear him? If it were possible for one of the disciples to speak in the Median tongue, and another in the Elamite tongue, then they would be able to converse with the Jewish synagogues and the gatherings of the Greeks, discussing the things that have been spoken about...
